versions.dm_opening: Fog rolls off the cistern row as the tide-bell tolls terce, and three of you stand at the base of the original cider apple — Mara kneeling at the weeping root flare, Lila clutching the copper pruning shears she's already sharpened twice, Javi hauling the last rain-barrel down from the heirloom guild beds because something has fouled the cistern water overnight with a faint sour reek. The neonatal blight is spreading faster than any text in Elara's journals promised, and Kaelin is still unaccounted for out at the mason bee boxes where the buzzing has gone strangely silent. Within the hour you must decide whether Lila cuts the infected flare wood tonight before the fog-borne spores ride the next tide-wind into the stone fruit barrier, or whether Mara's slow seaweed-and-ash packing buys the old tree time at the risk of everything planted since. Javi waits at the cistern valve, hands on the release that would flood the root cell with fresh rainwater — do you open it, or do you send someone running for Kaelin first?
